dct_title_s: Eastern part of the Celebes Sea. : Anchorages between Mindanao and Celebes
dct_description_sm: Mostly from Netherlands Government sketch surveys to 1917.
Relief shown by spot heights, contours, hachures; depths by soundings.
Soundings in fathoms, heights in feet.
Conversion table, buoy legend, authorities and lights text.

Maps: Arangkaa Anch. -- North Bay -- Lirung Road -- Sereh Bay -- Beo Bay -- Batumbaranggo Bay -- Tabukan Road -- Kulur Bay -- Kawio Anch. -- Ngalipaeng Bay -- Dago Bay -- Marore Island -- Palmas Island -- Essang Bay -- Sawang and Ulu Roads -- Peta Bay -- Buhias Road -- Menalu Road.
